positive_constraints: Use only as the canonical detective role kit alt_05_details source image.

Preserve Patch's core identity elements whenever visible in the detail frame: teal hoodie, hood antennae, off-white face panel, black oval eyes with white shine highlights, and teal crossbody bag with > mark.
Layer detective role accessories over Patch's core look without replacing the hoodie, antennae, or core silhouette.
Honor the exact RGBA pixel data and 1254x1254 dimensions.
Adhere to the recorded SHA-256 and byte size for cache and reproduction.
Use visible detail panels as the reference for detective kit costume elements.
negative_constraints: Do not use as a final runtime sprite without downscaling or format conversion.
Do not replace the teal hoodie with a full detective coat that obscures Patch's core identity.
Do not remove visible core identity elements such as the teal hoodie, antennae, face panel, or crossbody bag.
Do not infer additional poses, props, or characters beyond the shown details.
Do not infer missing pose variations, alternate costumes, or environment details beyond the visible frame.
Do not remix into non-detective role kits without explicit style-guide review.
